notes.title: Alien Scumbags Update V15.0.0
notes.content:
Hello again,

Initially this was meant to be a small update, however it turned into something much bigger.
As always I will run down the list of improvements first, followed by the bug fixes.

[b]Unleash Jason Moorcheese[/b]
If you play Alien Scumbags this Halloween you will able to unlock Jason straight away, this is only running until 31st of October so jump in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/b3c3372d214cd81eac36cbd9ab5bdc37977b18cb.png[/img]

[b]Radboy mode[/b]
If you complete the game on "Taste My Boomstick" or above you will now unlock Radboy mode so you can enjoy what Alien Scumbags would look like with CGA graphics. Finishing this mode is what took the most time as I have redrawn several enemies just for that mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/153ea48c917d324c81982e5bb8b15cc00b753174.png[/img]

[b]Improvements to Air Boost[/b]
You can now boost while falling making the Air Boost mechanic much more fun

[b]Lockers are no longer safe![/b]
I have made some fun changes for anyone playing above "I'm Fragile"/"Pussy" 
If you get into the locker too late while an Alien is chasing you down they will now destroy it and eat your face, makes the experience of using lockers much more tense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/e3914d8f796d0bef88f5da7dd973d3369bd9c4a4.png[/img]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug fix for running sfx when paused
[*] Shooting through wall fix on L4
[*] Fix for creating too many sparks on L12
[*] Fix for L2 vending machine collision
[*] Fix for L12 zombies dying randomly
[/list]

Happy Halloween and I hope you have a great time with the new update.

If you complete the game on "Taste My Boomstick" or above you will now unlock Radboy mode so you can enjoy what Alien Scumbags would look like with CGA graphics.
You can now boost while falling making the Air Boost mechanic much more fun

notes.title: Final big update, V14 now available!
notes.content:
This is it everyone! One 48 hour gamejam and 3.5 years later has brought us to this point.
Alien Scumbags last big update!

Before I get into the main features I want to say a huge thank you for all your support.

[b]New stuff[/b]
Get ready to face off against the final boss, Dr Darc-Ass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/c289644d312c7bed70111f2a321acf4124f703ca.png[/img]

Checkpoints have now been added, but in true Alien Scumbags style they are not your usual checkpoints. You can choose to save your progress on the level or deactivate the checkpoint and cause chaos with a variety of Nostrami drones, not to mention that you also get a shiny gold coin for choosing to deactivate the checkpoints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/2caa56343540ba4aae5c15dc94e672776a115e41.png[/img]

[b]Final cutscene[/b]
You can now officially finish Alien Scumbags.

[b]Other changes include:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now kill Gordon on L1
[*] You can now kill the civilians in the Kitchen
[*] Improved instructions on cart L3
[*] More things added to environments
[*] Improved barrels on boss 2
[*] Added off screen indicator to level 11
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Many things have been addressed including:
[list]
[*] Removed smoke when running in acid
[*] Aiming Reticule no longer shows on pause screen 
[*] Jumping in lockers
[*] Layering issues
[/list]

[b]What's next for Alien Scumbags?[/b]
So the next thing for Alien Scumbags is to do any further bug fixes, look into implementing key binding for people now using controllers, add some the missing audio tapes and story, these updates will be much smaller, but will just give some extra polish.

[b]What's next for Monster Finger Games?[/b]
Work has started on a new project called Tanks A Lot, its a precision platformer with a jelly tank, I will be creating the Steam page soon so hope you will give it a wishlist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/6fc5f8a4c24c5b19ac65fe4828c540485758de3b.png[/img]

notes.title: New update V13!
notes.content:
Alien Scumbags has reached it's next big milestone with version 13!
Before I get into the details of this update I want to say a huge thank you for all the support so far, Alien Scumbags wouldn't be what it is today without you.

Ok let's talk about the update.

[b]New additions:[/b]
[b]Alien Scumbros mode added[/b]
This new mode is a fast and frantic experience set on a single screen, use all your skills to fight the endless waves of aliens and demons, with each waves giving new enemies. 
Its a way to experience most of the content in the main game, without having to replay the levels again.

Alien Scumbros mode comes with it's own offline and online leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/cd459c9b9654571d77e4e70b57b7ed9e34e9131d.png[/img]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] 0.5 second cool down added to grenade launcher
[*] Enemy sensor improvement
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemy fall at ladder on L2
[*] Enemy movement fix on L7
[*] Fixed censorship bug
[*] Fixed Ammo visual bug on L1
[*] Fixed score issue at continue screen
[*] Shotgun and Lazer sound fixed so no more noise when not firing a shot
[*] Visual glitch fix for mech level
[*] Zombie fix on mech level
[*] Boss 1 activation fix
[*] Gun/arm visual issue on tutorial level fixed
[*] Ladder fix on L4
[/list]

[b]What's next?[/b]
In the next update you will be able to face off against the final boss.
Alien Scumbags is very close to being complete now, however I may added further content too.

notes.content:
Here we are again everyone at another big milestone for Alien Scumbags.

[b]To celebrate the new version we have a 30% off sale right now![/b]

Here is what is available in V11 for you to enjoy:

[b]Let's start with the new additions:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/37adca8bf8b21ffe1711ea0e52d54166255f6799.png[/img]

This was something that wasn't originally planned for Alien Scumbags, however after putting out a Twitter poll and watching a Youtuber find it highly offensive I felt it was the right time to give people the option of censoring the game.

Playing the game in censored mode will bleep out the swearing, change the name of some of the difficulty levels and remove some of the pixel nudity as well as toning down the blood and gore effects.

notes.title: New update V10
notes.content:
This post will cover what's changed in V10.0.0 to V10.0.3

Ok let's talk about the new content and changes made, after that I'll go onto the bug fixes.

[b]Content and changes[/b]
[b]New boss added[/b]
A new boss battle has been added, dodge the explosive barrels as they rain down from above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/ffc0e29294495d01011b47ea5c095474e6fadb67.png[/img]

[b]Dave's Emporium added[/b]
Stop by Dave's Emporium for all your ammunition needs

[b]Acid is physics based now[/b]
This is something I am really proud off, you can now bounce around making waves, don't do it for too long though or you will die! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37796124/0b1bedf4b08e81f72b79b4dad65984a4841f1d7d.png[/img]

[b]New song's added to L4 and L11[/b]
More haunting sci-fi melodies have been created by our music wizard Stu

[b]Improved lazer damage on boxes[/b]

[b]Pressing ESC/Circle or B on the Xbox controller will now exit character selection[/b]

[b]Added ability to continue die fully[/b]
I want everyone to be able to enjoy all the content in Alien Scumbags so now when you die fully you can still restart from the last level, however your score will be reset.

[b]Medpack icon now flashes when you have a medpack available[/b]
So many people have died because they didn't realise that they had a medpack, now if you have spare health it will flash at the top so you won't miss it.

[b]Box shards now damage boxes[/b]

[b]Mech gun moves faster[/b]

[b]Heads can now be shot on Mech level[/b]
Get practicing your aim for the upcoming achievements 

[b]Fixes[/b]
Fix for tape on L10
Fix for locker on tutorial
Fixes on various levels for dropping medpacks
L4 double death bug fixed
Boss 2 exploit fixed
Purple monsters are slower
Purple monsters now run slower

notes.title: Spooky Halloween update now available!
notes.content:
***New spooky update available now***

The update gives a new Halloween theme for a limited time, complete with pumpkins and gravestones, you are going to have one hell of a time!

Check out all the other amazing new additions below:

[b]New gun added[/b]
The latest gun fires circular saw blades, but be careful not to get in the way of them yourself.

[b]New level[/b]
Get your groove on in the latest level as you visit the ships Nightclub/bar Molly Cools.

[b]New song[/b]

[b]New intro[/b]
Hear the final communication of the Nostrami (featuring the amazing voice talents of Tristabytes)

[b]Fast reload[/b]
Press fire at just the right time during the reload to get a super quick reload

[b]Steam achievements[/b]
11 new Steam achievements with more to come in further updates

[b]Radboy mode[/b]
Beat the game without killing anything to unlock this old school mode

[b]Pacifist mode[/b]
Can you beat the game without killing anything?

[b]New content for L4, L6 and L10[/b]
Some new areas added and some other ones improved

[b][/b]More info on Tally Screen
You can now see lots of new random stats such as how many coins collected, secrets found etc

[b]Interaction icon[/b]
There is lots of random stuff you can interact with so a an icon will now show over your head so you know it is interactive

[b]FPS improvements[/b]
To be honest this more for me and my ancient laptop as not known anyone to have an issue with FPS apart from me

[b]Changed sound for big aliens[/b]
The screams didn't match the giant aliens and they were also a little ear piercing so now they have been changed

[b]Fixed overlap with boxes[/b]
Finally fixed the overlap issue with boxes which caused your character to slide through them

[b]Fix for accidental use of grenade launcher[/b]

[b]Portal fix[/b]

[b]Window no longer snaps to the top left[/b]

I hope you love the new update and thanks for your continued support.

James

notes.title: Big update is here!!! (v7.9)
notes.content:
Great news everyone! The new version of Alien Scumbags has now released and its a big one.
Lets talk about what's new!

[list]
[*] Further amendments to inventory
[*] Improvements for L5
[*] New level added
[*] Upwards firing
[*] Improved face hugger movements
[*] New voicework added
[*] Added new ceiling enemies to make upward firing more useful
[*] Some object GFX improvements
[*] Use button added for switches/interactivity
[*] More interactivity with objects
[*] Aliens can now run from bombs
[/list]

Here is a bit more detail, to start with the new update adds a new level making the total 11, as well as that you can interact with more stuff, for example you can use the taps, vending machines, switches etc.
The next big thing is we have voice acting in the latest version from the Youtuber and streamer TristaBytes.

People wanted to have upward firing so that has now been added as well as having ceiling based enemies, some other improvements include improved enemy actions such as Aliens being able to run away from grenades, come down ladders and walk up steps.

We have a new song in the works for the latest level so will be updating the game again soon to add that in.

Until next time thank you for following and supporting the development of Alien Scumbags.
